alt_text: Exponent map for coprime-prime blocks with modulus K of order T to the theta and prime scale P of order T to the xi. Blue is Baker only, ochre is Fouvry–Shparlinski only, and violet is their overlap. Stronger fill above the descending dashed line xi = 1 − theta shows the additional prime region beyond the limiting elementary short-factor cutoff. The vertical dotted line at theta = 9/17 marks the separate all-square result to its left and does not bound the prime regions. The prime estimates hold at strict interior points for a fixed transition exponent sufficiently close to one. Longer primes remain outside the shaded regions.
elementary_limiting_short_factor_region: xi < 1 - theta as kappa tends to 1 from below
scope: Strict interiors, fixed sufficiently close kappa < 1, no numerical onset, longer primes open.
stronger_fill_region: the union of the two prime regions intersected with xi > 1 - theta
